title: An Upper Bound for the Mean Speed of Transition Fronts and Unbounded Front Widths for Fisher KPP Equations in Almost Periodic Media
summary: In this paper, we investigate transition fronts and spreading solutions of Fisher--KPP equations in one-dimensional almost periodic media, both on the real line and on the lattice. Let $λ_1$ be the supremum of the spectrum of the linearized operator acting on $L^2(\R)$ or $\ell^2(\Z)$, respectively, and let \(L(λ_1)\) denote the spatial Lyapunov exponent at the spectral parameter \(λ_1\). We prove that, if $L(λ_1)>0$, the global mean speed of any transition front is at most $λ_1/L(λ_1)$.
